original_ai_output.title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚首都禁止无人机飞行后传出爆炸声
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴夜间传出爆炸声，居民和外交消息人士称，一处位于西部军事总部附近，另一处在城市南部。爆炸发生前数小时，当局禁止在亚的斯亚贝巴上空飞行无人机；此前一周，政府军与包括提格雷地区武装在内的新联盟在首都以北爆发战斗。与反对派武装有关联的消息人士向路透社声称，爆炸是其所为的无人机袭击。官方尚未确认爆炸原因、具体地点及是否有伤亡或损失。

location.raw_text: Ethiopia's capital, some in the area of the military headquarters in the west and another in the south of the city

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚首都夜间传出爆炸声，一处在西部军事总部附近，另一处在城市南部
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Explosions were heard overnight in Ethiopia's capital, some in the area of the military headquarters in the west and another in the south of the city, residents and diplomatic sources say.

key_facts.fact: 爆炸发生前数小时，当局禁止在亚的斯亚贝巴上空飞行无人机
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The blasts came hours after drone flights were banned over Addis Ababa

key_facts.fact: 与反对派武装有关联的消息人士向路透社声称对无人机袭击负责
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A source linked to the opposition fighters told the Reuters news agency they were behind what they said were drone strikes.

key_facts.fact: 官方尚未确认爆炸原因、具体地点及是否有伤亡或损失
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: There were no official reports confirming the cause of the explosions, the exact locations affected or whether there were any casualties or damage.

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚外交部宣布关闭驻厄立特里亚使馆并驱逐10名厄立特里亚外交官
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ethiopia's foreign ministry has said it is closing its embassy in neighbouring Eritrea and expelling 10 Eritrean diplomats "for involvement in activities that pose a direct threat to Ethiopia's national security".

key_facts.fact: 一周前政府军与包括提格雷地区武装在内的新联盟在首都以北爆发战斗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a week after fighting erupted in the north between the army and a newly launched alliance of armed groups including forces from the Tigray region

uncertainties: 爆炸原因、具体地点及是否有伤亡或损失尚未获得官方确认
